# Augur Lituus

> Real-world answers for onchain apps, controlled by no one.

Augur Lituus is the next generation of Augur's oracle. Anyone can answer, anyone can challenge, and every challenge doubles the cost of a lie. Each page has a plain Markdown version, listed below.

## Pages

- [Home](/index.md): What Augur Lituus is, what it can power, how reporting and challenging work, and the roadmap.
- [About](/about.md): What Augur is, its history from 2015, and who does what: the Lituus Foundation, ChainSafe, Dark Florist and REP holders.
- [Products](/products.md): Augur Lituus, Zoltar and Augur Statoblast, how they fit together, and their status (all in development).
- [REP](/rep.md): The REP token: which version is current, the contract address, how bonds and forks work, and what holders can do.
- [FAQ](/faq.md): Short answers about Augur, how questions get settled, REP and building with Augur.
- [Learn](/learn.md): The guide list (only one guide is written so far) and key terms.
- [Brand](/brand.md): Logo, color and typeface guidance, and the brand asset download.
- [Contact](/contact.md): A form page: the fields it asks for, the notice about how messages are used, and other ways to reach the team.

## Guides

- [How Augur answers a question](/learn/how-augur-answers-a-question.md): Ask, report, challenge, final answer: one example from start to finish.
